description:
Browses GA4GH RNAget metadata and retrieves expression or continuous matrix data through policy-enforced ticket requests and anonymous byte fetches.

**Install**: not published to npm or any other package registry. Clone and build the `ga4gh-plugins` repository, then run this package's standalone stdio MCP server with Node, using an absolute path:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/susheel/ga4gh-plugins.git
cd ga4gh-plugins && pnpm install && pnpm run build
GA4GH_RNAGET_ALLOW_UNENFORCED_MCP=true GA4GH_RNAGET_BASE_URL=https://your-rnaget-endpoint.example.org \
  node /absolute/path/to/ga4gh-plugins/packages/rnaget/lib/bin.js
```

The standalone server has no GA4GH policy enforcement point in scope and refuses to start unless `GA4GH_RNAGET_ALLOW_UNENFORCED_MCP=true` is set. Run the Cordis plugin instead where GA4GH Passport/Visa policy enforcement is required.
